# Installing Slurm

##  Headnode 
1. Installing slurmctld, slurmdbd, slurm-client

  ` root@headnode$>  apt install slurm-wlm`

2. Install slurm.conf

  - Copy slurm.conf to /etc/slurm
  - Stop and start the slurmctld service

Slurm.conf  

```
# slurm.conf file generated by configurator easy.html.
# Put this file on all nodes of your cluster.
# See the slurm.conf man page for more information.
#
####################
ClusterName=txpi4
SlurmctldHost=headnode
#MailProg=/bin/mail
MpiDefault=none
#MpiParams=ports=#-#
ProctrackType=proctrack/cgroup
ReturnToService=2
SlurmctldPidFile=/var/run/slurmctld.pid
SlurmctldPort=6817
SlurmdPidFile=/var/run/slurmd.pid
SlurmdPort=6818
SlurmdSpoolDir=/var/lib/slurm/slurmd
SlurmUser=slurm
#SlurmdUser=root
StateSaveLocation=/var/lib/slurm/slurmctld
SwitchType=switch/none
TaskPlugin=task/affinity,task/cgroup
#
##############
# TIMERS
#KillWait=30
#MinJobAge=300
#SlurmctldTimeout=120
#SlurmdTimeout=300
#
##############
# SCHEDULING
SchedulerType=sched/backfill
SelectType=select/cons_tres
#
##############
# LOGGING
#SlurmctldDebug=info
SlurmctldLogFile=/var/log/slurm/slurmctld.log
#SlurmdDebug=info
SlurmdLogFile=/var/log/slurm/slurmd.log
#
##############
# ACCOUNTING
AccountingStorageType=accounting_storage/slurmdbd
AccountingStorageHost=headnode
AccountingStoragePort=6819
#JobAcctGatherFrequency=30
#JobAcctGatherType=jobacct_gather/none
JobAcctGatherType=jobacct_gather/linux
#
###############
# COMPUTE NODES
#NodeName=node[1-3]  Feature=BCM2711  RealMemory=8000 Sockets=1 CoresPerSocket=4  CPUs=4 State=UNKNOWN
NodeName=node1  Feature=BCM2711   Sockets=1 CoresPerSocket=4  CPUs=4 State=UNKNOWN
NodeName=node2  Feature=BCM2711   Sockets=1 CoresPerSocket=4  CPUs=4 State=UNKNOWN
NodeName=node3  Feature=BCM2711   Sockets=1 CoresPerSocket=4  CPUs=4 State=UNKNOWN
PartitionName=pi4 Nodes=ALL Default=YES MaxTime=INFINITE State=UP

```
